# Confluence Test Artifacts

Use this skill for Test Plan or Test Case publication.

- Confirm Confluence space, source page, parent page, and available authentication before publishing.
- Use local time in `YYYY-MM-DD_HH-mm` page/file names.
- Test Case Generator must create a new page every run; never update an earlier generated result.
- Keep `Test Cases` and `Automation Candidates` separate in both Confluence sections and Excel sheets.
- Include source URL, generation timestamp, workspace, acceptance-criteria mapping, and artifact links.
- Report permission, API, upload, or formatting failures explicitly.
